name: bdf_get_exchange_rate
description:
An ECB euro reference exchange rate, daily (business days): units of USD, GBP, JPY or CNY per one euro, series EXR.D.<currency>.EUR.SP00.A.
Returns: series_code (ECB flow.key), series_id, label, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs (none required): currency_pair (eur_usd, eur_gbp, eur_jpy, eur_cny; default eur_usd); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
ecb_get_exchange_rate reads the same series and adds eur_chf.
Example: {"currency_pair": "eur_usd", "start_date": "2026-01-01", "end_date": "2026-03-31"}
